label: gateway.payment-required
answers: Your Gladys Plus subscription is suspended: a payment is required. Backups, Enedis synchronization and AI features are paused on this instance. To fix it, update your payment method in your Gladys Plus account (https://plus.gladysassistant.com/dashboard/settings/billing), then click "Check again" in "Settings" => "Gladys Plus". Everything resumes automatically once the payment is received, nothing is lost.

label: gateway.subscription-active
answers: Your Gladys Plus subscription is active again. Backups, Enedis synchronization and AI features are back on.
